risks.evidence_gap: No governed pilot or production environment, protected deployment control or environment approval evidence.
risks.closure: Approved environment record, protected deployment path, tested rollback and named activation authority.
risks.carry_forward: Blocking when any environment or approval evidence is missing.

risks.evidence_gap: No signed provenance, signed release artifact or immutable signed audit evidence.
risks.closure: Independent verification succeeds for source, package and approval record, with approved key custody.
risks.carry_forward: Blocking when provenance cannot be independently verified.

risks.evidence_gap: No remote telemetry, alert delivery, paging, SLO evidence or long-term evidence store.
risks.closure: Critical signals are remotely retained, alerts are acknowledged and retention/redaction tests pass.
risks.carry_forward: Restricted pilot only with explicitly approved manual compensating monitoring.

risks.evidence_gap: No vulnerability-intelligence integration or repository-history secret scan.
risks.closure: No unresolved critical finding or exposed credential; all exceptions have owner, expiry and approval.
risks.carry_forward: Blocking for production; pilot exception must be explicit and time-bounded.

risks.evidence_gap: No load, capacity, availability, endurance, backup-restore or external disaster-recovery qualification.
risks.closure: Approved performance envelope, availability evidence, successful restore and external recovery exercise.
risks.carry_forward: Blocking when pilot-exit evidence or recovery objectives are unmet.
